shots.cue: Did this black box model train on your graph data?
TAG Finger leaves the released dataset unchanged. On an audit copy, we focus on a local, predictively stable graph region.
A language model proposes text edits. The same text encoder re-encodes them. A query-based surrogate selects edits that strengthen the target response and regional drift.
Now query the suspected model on clean and edited inputs. A change toward each task's target contributes positive evidence. Compatible tasks contribute separate votes.
Two positive votes meet the three-task majority threshold. Unchanged predictions contribute zero evidence, not a no-use verdict.
TAG Finger. From graph semantics to ownership evidence.

disclaimer: All graph examples, text edits, probability shapes, and votes are schematic. No experimental performance value is shown.
audio: Local synthetic speech plus original procedural bed and accents
